tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum

(nya)pa'i dkar chag / ka bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i dkyil chog dbang rdo rje'i phreng ba/ 1 kha bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor*/29 ga bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus/91 nga dpal kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i phreng ba/75 ca dpal kun tu kha sbyor gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i dkyil chog dbang gi chu bo/147 cha dpal dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa don gnyis mchog stsol/ ja dpal sambu ṭa nas gsungs pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/359 nya dpal sambu ṭa'i dgongs pa dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun gyi mchod pa'i cho ga dkyil 'khor bzhi'i dga' ston/421 ta sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sgyu 'phrul mchog sbyin/469 tha sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul mchog grub/565 da sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga sgyu 'phrul las sgrub/597 na bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i rdzogs rim snying po don gyi phreng ba u pa de sha gaṃ bhī ra/617
